hints.title: Target Remainder
hints.text: Let rem = sum(nums) % p. If rem == 0, no elements need to be removed (return 0).

hints.title: Subarray Remainder Matching
hints.text: Removing a subarray with sum S makes the remaining sum divisible by p if and only if S % p == rem.

hints.title: Prefix Sum Remainder Table
hints.text: Maintain the latest index for each prefix sum modulo p in a lookup collection. Find the shortest subarray with prefix remainder (cur - rem + p) % p.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Testing all O(N^2) subarrays takes quadratic time, giving TLE on N = 10^5.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Hash table lookup finds matching modular prefix sums in O(1), operating in O(N) time and space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate transforms whole-array divisibility into prefix modular difference and prevents removing the whole array.
